category_description: Public pensions and retirement benefits in Canada.
subcategory_description: The Canada Pension Plan retirement pension and how it is worked out.
label: Maximum monthly CPP retirement pension at age 65
context: The maximum is not guaranteed. The actual pension depends on contribution history and the age at which it starts.

label: Average monthly CPP retirement pension at age 65
context: An average across pensioners, not an amount anyone is guaranteed. The source dates this figure to July 2026.
